Definition: Pokereth-Tsebajim, one of the 'servants of Solomon'
BiblicalUsage: Pokereth-Tsebajim was one of the servants of Solomon whose children returned from exile. The name stands twice, in Ezra 2:57 and Nehemiah 7:59, in the lists of those who came up with Zerubbabel — a family counted among the restored remnant.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the servants of Solomon are remembered with the priests and the princes — God counts the household too.
